turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook, and why didn't anyone call me first?
I'm waiting, Hale. Who decided, and on what basis?
"Mm-hm" isn't an answer, Hale. I'm writing down that I've asked twice who decided and you haven't said. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is called before any mark goes in, so tell me why nobody called me.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.

"Stopped listening" goes in my notes, Hale. I have until 4:40, and then I go upstairs to the principal with a zero that was entered before anyone called me. Withdraw it now, or give me a reason I can check.
